title: RuleFrontmatter
description: Validated header for .claude/rules/*.md so the self-check can verify the CLAUDE.MD -> rules -> skills -> scripts chain mechanically. Every skill and script a rule points to must exist (dangling pointers are drift findings).

paths.description: Glob patterns this rule loads for. Use ["**"] for always-load rules.

skills.description: Skill names this rule points to.

scripts.description: Repo-relative paths to deterministic scripts this rule relies on.

hooks.description: Repo-relative paths to hooks that enforce this rule.
